llm_response.reason: The website displays multiple scam traits: the domain was registered extremely recently with a registrant in China despite targeting European customers, has no company information, no physical address, no professional contact options, only generic safety claims, and mimics the Jane Lushka brand without public verification. Its contact page lacks proper business channels (email/phone), and independent reputation or reviews are missing. These match several classic indicators of fake e-commerce scams.
